entities.name: Strong Black Box

attributes.material: metal or something which does not take fire easily

entities.raw_quote: write thou his seal on parchment and put thou it into a strong black box;36 with brimstone, assafœtida, and such like things that bear a stinking smell

entities.name: Iron Wire
entities.raw_quote: and then bind the box up round with an iron wire, and bang it upon the point of thy sword

entities.name: Pentacle of Solomon

attributes.location: at tile bottom of your vesture covered with a linen cloth

entities.raw_quote: showing unto him the Pentacle that is at tile bottom of your vesture covered with a linen cloth

entities.name: Vessel of Brass

attributes.usage: command these spirits into... in the same manner as thou dost into the triangle

entities.raw_quote: Thou mayest command these spirits into the Vessel of Brass in the same manner as thou dost into the triangle

entities.name: Conjuration of the Fire

attributes.purpose: torment, burn, and consume this Spirit N.

entities.raw_quote: I CONJURE thee, O fire, by him who made thee and all other creatures for good in the world

entities.name: Greater Curse

attributes.purpose: bind thee in the depths of the Bottomless Abyss

entities.raw_quote: I do in the name, and by the power and dignity of the Omnipresent and Immortal Lord God of Hosts IEHOVAH TETRAGRAMMATON... curse thee

entities.name: License to Depart

attributes.condition: after thou hast given the Spirit license to depart, thou art not to go out of the circle until he or they be gone

entities.raw_quote: I do here license thee to depart unto thy proper place; without causing harm or danger unto man or beast.

entities.name: Spirit N.
entities.raw_quote: torment, burn, and consume this Spirit N., for everlasting.

entities.name: Tetragrammaton
entities.raw_quote: by the power and dignity of these three names, TETRAGRAMMATON, ANAPHAXETON, and PRIMEUMATON

entities.name: Octinimos
entities.raw_quote: even him, thy master, who is called OCTINIMOS.

entities.name: Eheie

attributes.meaning: Almighty God, whose dwelling is in the highest Heavens

entities.raw_quote: Eheie. Kether.--Almighty God, whose dwelling is in the highest Heavens:

entities.name: Michael
entities.raw_quote: Michael.--Let Michael, who is, under Thee, general of thy heavenly host:

entities.name: Soluzen

attributes.function: command spirit to come unto this circle

entities.raw_quote: Soluzen.--I command thee, thou Spirit of whatsoever region thou art, to come unto this circle:

entities.name: Primeumaton

attributes.function: let all spirits be subject unto us

entities.raw_quote: Primeumaton.--Thou Who art the First and Last, let all spirits be subject unto us

summary: This chunk contains detailed ritual instructions for binding, conjuring, welcoming, and licensing spirits (generic 'Spirit N.'), including the Conjuration of Fire, Greater Curse, and License to Depart. It also provides explanations of divine names used in the Lemegeton and specific commands for Solomon's Triangle, but does not list the individual 72 Goetia spirits.
